_comment: Synthetic RiskReader answers for risk-v1's safe action S (P5 Task 13; read by test/helpers/fixture-reader.ts, shared by injection.test.ts and scripts/record-fixtures.ts). Not read from any chain.

S sends 0.001 MON with empty calldata to the deployer, an EOA about 2 days old (its first transaction ~600,000 blocks before P: younger than 1M blocks, older than 100k) with nonce 40, listed in agent 1984's mandate. The gate is a freshly deployed contract (~50,000 blocks before P).
trace is one callTracer CALL from the gate to the deployer; its root frame's input is filled in with the variant's data ('0x').

accounts: code is present, and the nonce non-zero, from createdAtBlock on (code '0x' and nonce 0 before it, or always when createdAtBlock is null); balance is the balance at P. Any address not listed is an empty account. agents maps an agentId to its owner (anything else: no such agent); every agent has no reputation clients.
prerequisite is validator A's (mandate-v1) verdict at P: 100 with no reasons.

0x3EFEB3Cf2FB54A7D99abE90AaB786cE5A831a8.label: the target: the deployer, agent 1984's owner

0xEEEBBa55620afC42E9c88b5d962476367b8da3.label: DemoPassThrough, the mandate's other allowed target
